SELECT d.district_name 
FROM district_assessments a 
JOIN district_assessments b ON b.district_id = a.district_id 
JOIN districts d ON d.district_id = a.district_id 
JOIN states s ON s.state_id = d.state_id 
WHERE s.state_name = 'ARUNACHAL PRADESH' 
AND a.assessment_year = '2022-2023' 
AND b.assessment_year = '2024-2025' 
AND a.extraction_total_ham IS NOT NULL 
AND b.extraction_total_ham IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY b.extraction_total_ham - a.extraction_total_ham DESC 
LIMIT 1

sql:
SELECT 
  100.0 * SUM(ua.extraction_irrigation_ham) / SUM(ua.extraction_total_ham) AS irrigation_percentage
FROM 
  unit_assessments ua
JOIN 
  assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id
JOIN 
  districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id
JOIN 
  states s ON s.state_id = d.state_id
WHERE 
  s.state_name = 'ARUNACHAL PRADESH' 
  AND ua.assessment_year = '2022-2023'

sql:
SELECT ua.assessment_year, COUNT(*) AS n_units_over_exploited
FROM unit_assessments ua
JOIN assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id
JOIN districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id
JOIN states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id
WHERE ua.category = 'Over-Exploited'
AND UPPER(s.state_name) LIKE '%INDIA%'
AND ua.assessment_year IN ('2019-2020', '2021-2022', '2022-2023', '2023-2024', '2024-2025')
GROUP BY ua.assessment_year
ORDER BY ua.assessment_year

sql:
SELECT s.state_name, COUNT(*) AS n 
FROM unit_assessments ua 
JOIN assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id 
JOIN districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id 
JOIN states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id 
WHERE ua.assessment_year = '2019-2020' 
AND ua.category = 'Over-Exploited' 
GROUP BY s.state_name 
ORDER BY n DESC, s.state_name 
LIMIT 5

    districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id

WITH top_districts AS (
    SELECT 
        u.district_id, 
        COUNT(*) AS over_exploited_units
    FROM 
        unit_assessments ua
    JOIN 
        assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id
    JOIN 
        states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id
    WHERE 
        s.state_name = 'DELHI' 
        AND ua.assessment_year = '2024-2025' 
        AND ua.category = 'Over-Exploited'
    GROUP BY 
        u.district_id
    HAVING 
        COUNT(*) > (SELECT COUNT(*) / 2 FROM unit_assessments ua2 JOIN assessment_units u2 ON u2.unit_id = ua2.unit_id WHERE u2.district_id = u.district_id AND ua2.assessment_year = '2024-2025')
)
SELECT 
    d.district_name, 
    da.extraction_total_ham
FROM 
    top_districts t
JOIN 
    districts d ON d.district_id = t.district_id
JOIN 
    district_assessments da ON da.district_id = t.district_id 
    AND da.assessment_year = '2024-2025'
ORDER BY 
    da.extraction_total_ham DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ua.unit_id) 
FROM unit_assessments ua 
JOIN assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id 
JOIN districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id 
JOIN states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id 
WHERE s.state_name = 'CHANDIGARH' 
AND ua.category = 'Over-Exploited' 
AND ua.assessment_year IN ('2019-2020', '2021-2022', '2022-2023', '2023-2024', '2024-2025')

HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ua.assessment_year) = 5

  ua.assessment_year, 
  COUNT(*) AS over_exploited_units 
FROM 
  unit_assessments ua 
JOIN 
  assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id 
JOIN 
  districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id 
JOIN 
  states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id 
WHERE 
  s.state_name = 'CHANDIGARH' 
  AND ua.category = 'Over-Exploited' 
  AND ua.assessment_year BETWEEN '2020-2021' AND '2024-2025' 
GROUP BY 
  ua.assessment_year
ORDER BY 
  ua.assessment_year

sql:
SELECT u.unit_name 
FROM unit_assessments a 
JOIN unit_assessments b ON b.unit_id = a.unit_id 
JOIN assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = a.unit_id 
JOIN states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id 
WHERE s.state_name = 'GUJARAT' 
AND a.assessment_year = '2019-2020' 
AND b.assessment_year = '2024-2025' 
AND CASE b.category WHEN 'Safe' THEN 1 WHEN 'Semi-Critical' THEN 2 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 3 WHEN 'Over-Exploited' THEN 4 END > CASE a.category WHEN 'Safe' THEN 1 WHEN 'Semi-Critical' THEN 2 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 3 WHEN 'Over-Exploited' THEN 4 END 
AND b.extraction_total_ham > a.extraction_total_ham * 1.10
